selection: positive train return, >=20 closed trades, profit_factor>=1.1, risk_drawdown<=0.20 at all costs; maximize worst-cost return; else cash
assumptions: Fixed retrospective ETF universe; not point-in-time market-wide stock selection.
Daily regular-session close decisions execute at next exchange-session open; half-days and US DST use captured calendars.
Long-only cash proxy, integer board lots, equal initial capital sleeves; no leverage, shorts, FX netting or crypto funding.
Fees are conservative all-in per-side cost proxies with minimum charges, not an exact Longbridge tariff or market-impact model.
Dividends use ex-date nonspendable receivables; payment dates absent. US 30% haircut is a frozen research assumption, not investor-specific tax advice.
Yahoo corporate actions and calendar library are captured research inputs, not broker-certified records. Split events cause rejection.
Daily low equity is a conservative envelope, not synchronized intraday drawdown. Close drawdown is reported separately.
Sale proceeds are reusable at next daily decision; actual settlement, account trading restrictions and order execution remain unverified.
Holdout is a retrospective separated period. No result grants production eligibility.
US prices and all dividends from Yahoo; HK raw OHLCV from Tencent public day feed. Yahoo HK zero-volume and missing-price rows are not used for fills. Sources remain unverified by Longbridge.

excluded_universe.2828.HK: Yahoo dividend/action history begins in 2024 and cannot support the frozen 2018 warmup / 2020 training. Excluded for source completeness before any account returns were calculated.
